capabilities: Resize image embeds by dragging side handles or setting an exact pixel width
Open an image in a zoom viewer with fit-to-screen and 100% views
Add, hide, or remove captions saved as italic Markdown beside the embed
Edit embed links in Live Preview or select images via a command-palette picker
Delete an image file or a single embed using Obsidian's deletion settings
extras: The plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README notes a Korean usage guide and some UI labels are in Korean. It only works on local images in the note body in Live Preview and Reading view, not remote URLs, table cells, embedded notes, or Source mode.
problem: Obsidian offers no direct way to resize, zoom, or caption embedded images within a note, or to give repeated embeds of the same image different widths and captions.
summary: Adds side handles to resize local image embeds, a full-size zoom viewer, and captions stored as Markdown next to the embed.
